'''Goren-Bo''' was a [[Voss (species)|Voss]] [[Voss commandos|commando]] living on [[Voss]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Posted at the [[Gormak Lands]], he asked a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] individual to kill the vicious [[Nexu/Legends|nexu]] [[Grellik]], responsible for the death of his fellow commando [[Luta-Vel]].<ref name="TOR" />
